articles.title: Noida schools to remain closed on September 16? Officials respond to CJP Saurav Das's claim
articles.description: During his inspection of schools in Noida, part of the CJP's ongoing school audit campaign across several parts of the country, Das urged young people to conduct similar audits of government schools in their own areas.

articles.title: ‘Horrible, highly political’ ruling: Trump attacks Supreme Court after mail-in voting setback
articles.description: Trump's March executive order sought to restrict mail-in voting by requiring voter lists to be compiled and directing the US Postal Service to deliver ballots only to voters appearing on those lists.

articles.title: India’s unemployment rate holds at 5% in August as rural joblessness eases
articles.description: Urban unemployment rose to 6.8%, but a sharper fall in rural joblessness kept the overall rate unchanged; labour-force participation also edged higher

August retail inflation raises chances of RBI rate hike in October, say economists

articles.title: How much will Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal earn on Instagram? Ex-ADC to President Murmu launches subscriber-only content
articles.description: Retired Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal's Instagram subscriptions have ignited debate online. He offers exclusive content for ₹199 (iPhone) and ₹180 (Android) monthly.

articles.title: Remembering Rosalind Franklin, whose photograph was crucial to discovering DNA’s structure
articles.description: When the Nobel Prize for Physiology in 1962 was announced, the names on that list were Watson and Crick, shared with Wilkins. It was decades before Franklin’s true role in this path-breaking discovery came to be known to the world

articles.title: Expect EU to sign FTA and India-Canada negotiations to be completed by year-end, govt says
articles.description: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal will also be travelling to the U.S. at the end of September, during which he will likely hold a bilateral meeting with his U.S. counterpart to discuss trade issues, including the much-delayed interim trade agreement announced in February.

articles.description: According to Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal, this was the first time that merchandise export growth surpassed growth in imports in percentage as well as absolute value terms

articles.title: NPCI announces MDR for UPI; merchant transactions above Rs 2,000 to attract 0.4% charge
articles.description: While NPCI has not specified a threshold based on the size of a merchant’s turnover, it said in its announcement that vendors operating under the person-to-person merchant (P2PM) category will “enjoy a mandatory zero MDR”. Merchants in this category, typically small shopkeepers, street vendors and local businesses, are classified as those receiving less than Rs 1 lakh per month in their accounts through UPI.

articles.title: Why can no one win a trade war? WTO warns tariffs and trade blocs could hurt everyone
articles.description: Why no one can win a trade war? WTO warns that tariffs, trade barriers and geopolitical blocs could weaken global trade and economic growth.

articles.title: Consumer protection body imposes Rs 10 lakh penalty on Rapido for use of dark patterns
articles.description: The consumer watchdog found that Rapido used two practices classified as dark patterns - “confirm shaming” and “interface interference” - and directed the company to discontinue misleading prompts and practices that steer consumers towards higher payments, the CCPA said in a statement on Tuesday.

articles.title: FBI chief Kash Patel is set to face off with Democrats critical of his leadership at Senate hearing
articles.description: September 15 hearing is expected to be no less contentious given Democrats’ fierce criticism of Kash Patel’s leadership and conduct

articles.title: Study on Keralam ELSA-3 shipwreck shows persistent nurdle pollution, evolving ecological impacts
articles.description: In the aftermath of the May 2025 accident, the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) initiated short term (rapid) and long term (two years) impact assessment studies through Suganthi Devadason Marine Research Institute (SDMRI) in Thoothukudi.

articles.title: European chip startup Axelera wins AI factory supply deals and launches second chip
articles.description: CEO Fabrizio Del Maffeo in a phone call with Reuters declined to give precise details, but said the company now has more than 600 customers using Axelera's chips for applications in security, defence, in AI factories and in enterprise settings.

articles.title: As world debates risks of AI, China closes technology gap with US
articles.description: The US has outpaced China and other countries for years in AI model capabilities, research, citations and other areas. But China has been rapidly catching up as an AI superpower even as US-led restrictions have blocked China from accessing some of the most advanced technologies, including the cutting-edge chips and the machines to make them.

articles.title: China urges U.S. to ‘stop preparing for war in outer space’
articles.description: We urge the U.S. side to stop expanding its military capabilities and preparing for war in outer space, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said

articles.title: Gujarat police to query Google over 500,000 fake Gmail IDs linked to bomb hoax
articles.description: Gujarat police broke ‌up ⁠an email network this week that they described as sending “inter-state” bomb ⁠threats and arrested two individuals, uncovering 513,847 Gmail IDs and passwords being used since 2022.

articles.title: UPI MDR rates likely within a week, October rollout in sight
articles.description: This comes after a Monday notificationfrom the Department of Financial Services that narrowed the zero-charge mandate for UPI. The earlier notification barred banks and payment system providers from levying a direct or indirect charge on UPI transactions, irrespective of value. The revised notification retains that protection only for transactions of up to Rs 2,000.

articles.title: Former Andhra Pradesh deputy CM Srinivas dies of heart attack
articles.description: Former Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Alla Nani passed away suddenly from a heart attack. He was 56 years old at the time of his untimely passing. Nani had previously served as Deputy CM and health minister under the YSRCP government. Following his election loss, he switched his political affiliation to the TDP party. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and IT Minister Nara Lokesh expressed their deep condolences.

articles.title: MediaTek launches new mobile chip using TSMC's most advanced technology
articles.description: MediaTek said the Dimensity 9600 Pro is its first mobile processor built using Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ​Co's cutting-edge 2-nanometre process. It also introduced the Dimensity 9600M, made using TSMC's 3-nanometre process and aimed at a broader segment of the flagship smartphone market.

articles.title: Retail inflation at 4.8 per cent highest in 12 yrs of Modi govt: Pralhad Joshi
articles.description: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi acknowledged rising retail inflation, citing El Nino and natural calamities as causes. He stated efforts are underway to bring inflation under control, contrasting it with past UPA tenures. The minister also promoted the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan campaign for public input. This initiative aims to gather ideas for developing India by 2047. Joshi also criticised the Congress party's stance on Hindu festival celebrations.

articles.title: US senators weigh requiring AI giants to commit to preventing catastrophe
articles.description: The senators are debating giving the U.S. commerce secretary the power ​to request evidence that ‌AI developers are taking reasonable steps to prevent harm

articles.title: Voice to capital: What India’s Brics summit leaves behind
articles.description: Brics needs to make investment in emerging markets easier to understand, easier to de-risk and more attractive to both domestic and global capital.

articles.title: Should conglomerate holding companies be listed?
articles.description: The case for listing Tata Sons is gaining urgency, but a public listing is no cure-all.

articles.title: Amazon's AWS is unable to restore access to Bahrain, one UAE cloud data zone after war damage
articles.description: Amazon's cloud computing unit AWS said the damage in Bahrain spanned multiple so-called availability zones, which are clusters of one or more data centres in the same geographic region.

articles.title: Learning on the job is crucial for certain professions but AI threatens to automate it away
articles.description: Lawyers and mathematicians have something in common—AI has invaded tasks that exercise the mental faculties of learners. It's wise not to adopt AI blindly in fields where working problems out is at the heart of professional knowledge acquisition.

articles.title: India’s gold appetite cools? Govt data shows imports plunge 57.7% as exports surge 26.12 %
articles.description: India’s gold imports plunged 57.7% to $2.3 billion in August even as overall imports rose 14.1%, while exports surged 26.1%.

articles.title: NATO jets down drone in Lithuanian airspace after bloc warns strikes will drive support for Ukraine
articles.description: Lithuania's military said that the incident marked the first time that a drone had been shot down in the country's airspace

articles.title: JD(U) won't oppose UCC if provisions are okay: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister
articles.description: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Vijay Kumar Chaudhary stated the JD(U) will study the Uniform Civil Code Bill. The party will not oppose the legislation without valid reasons for objection. Senior JD(U) leader Shyam Rajak had previously voiced strong opposition to the Uniform Civil Code. Chaudhary clarified that the party will consult coalition partners before making a final decision. The Union Agriculture Minister will visit flood-hit areas for damage assessment.

articles.title: AAP-GFP alliance for Goa polls a tacit understanding with BJP: Congress
articles.description: The Congress party has labeled the AAP and GFP alliance as an "exchange offer" deal. This alleged deal aims to secure victories for the BJP in Goa and AAP in Punjab. The "Goa First" alliance was formed to challenge the ruling BJP in upcoming elections. Congress claims this alliance serves BJP interests rather than the people of Goa. The party predicts rejection for these parties in the upcoming polls.

articles.title: DMK leaders A Raja, Sekar Babu booked for defamatory remarks against TN CM Vijay
articles.description: Cases have been filed against senior DMK leaders A Raja and P K Sekar Babu. These leaders allegedly made defamatory remarks against the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister. The protests were organised following the Chief Minister's comments on M K Stalin's detention. Raja and Babu are accused of making derogatory statements during party demonstrations. The police registered these cases based on specific complaints lodged by party functionaries.

articles.title: Paytm will stay profitable even without MDR, government support: Vijay Shekhar Sharma
articles.description: His comments come as the government moves towards allowing charges on a limited set of UPI transactions. On Monday, the government notified that UPI transactions of up to Rs 2,000 will remain free of MDR, while leaving the door open for levies on higher-value transactions.

articles.title: Export surge, lower gold imports narrow August trade deficit
articles.description: Merchandise exports surge 26.12% on-year to $43.81 billion, even as imports climb 14% to $70.67 billion.

articles.title: Morgan Stanley sees two Fed rate hikes in 2026
Mizoram yields two new-to-science frog species, one hiding in plain sight
articles.description: Duttaphrynus phawngpui and Ingerana aizawl named after Mizoram’s highest peak and its capital; one species was long mistaken for a widespread frog

articles.title: Himalaya approaching tipping point, report says
articles.description: Peak water, the point in time when river flows stop rising and ​start declining, could happen by mid-century

articles.title: Andy Mukherjee: Has Sebi lost its nerve on auctions for stock-market closing price discovery?
articles.description: There's no doubt India needs market depth, but its regulator seems to have given up on a reform it had instituted recently. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has asked for a discussion on whether to shorten the auction window or roll the idea back (effectively). This is disappointing

articles.title: Suvendu Adhikari backs Hasirani Rath for record Nandigram bypoll win, puts minority voters to test
articles.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari predicted a record victory for BJP candidate Hasirani Rath in Nandigram. He urged minority voters to support the BJP government in upcoming by-elections. Adhikari assured the people of Nandigram that all promises made would be fulfilled. The Chief Minister also pledged to withdraw false cases against BJP workers. He stated the government would work for the welfare and progress of West Bengal.

articles.title: Fear of government turns democracy into authoritarianism, says Karnataka CM D K Shivakumar
articles.description: Democracy transforms into authoritarianism when citizens fear their government. Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar stressed this point on Tuesday. He stated that democracy requires respecting people and ensuring their rights. Shivakumar highlighted India's long democratic tradition and the Anubhava Mantapa. He emphasized that democracy is about living with dignity and equal opportunity.

articles.title: Assume leadership, put nation first, FM Sitharaman tells Gen Z, Gen Alpha
articles.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged young graduates to prioritize national interests in leadership roles. She highlighted India's economic resilience amid global uncertainties and strong growth. Tamil Nadu offers growing opportunities for young professionals in technology and manufacturing. The Union Budget includes provisions to increase women's workforce participation. Graduates were advised to remain humble and approach challenges with patience.

articles.title: Google faces police questioning over 500,000 fake Gmail accounts used for bomb threats
articles.description: Indian police will question Google regarding safeguards after dismantling a fake Gmail account network. This network sent over 500,000 hoax bomb threats to government offices across India. Authorities arrested two individuals involved in operating this extensive criminal operation since 2022. The investigation began after a bomb threat email targeted the Gujarat government before a summit. Police are examining how the criminals bypassed security measures, including two-factor authentication.

articles.title: Dani Rodrik: Services have served us a surprise revolution of productivity across the world
articles.description: Globally, services have turned more productive than economists expected, but the benefits of it are not widely shared. Policy measures need to kick in for productivity gains to uplift lives all around—but without getting in the way of this revolution.

articles.title: 'If allies aren't ready, how will UCC be implemented': Omar Abdullah challenges BJP
Congress' 'Mohabbat ki Dukan' running business of corruption: BJP's Bansuri Swaraj
articles.description: The BJP has accused Rahul Gandhi of remaining silent on corruption allegations against Congress leaders. Enforcement Directorate actions targeted associates of former chief ministers in Uttarakhand and Chhattisgarh. The party also criticised Congress chief ministers for not attending a BRICS summit dinner. This absence was termed shameful and a sign of opposing national interest. The BJP questioned if Congress opposes Maa Bharati while opposing Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

articles.title: As NDA partner, TDP bound by Amit Shah's statement on UCC: P Srinivasa Rao
articles.description: TDP leader P Srinivasa Rao supports the Union Home Minister's statement on UCC introduction. He believes UCC will strengthen national unity and reduce gender bias. CPI(M) state secretary V Srinivas Rao criticizes the BJP's UCC agenda. He claims the BJP uses UCC politics to divert attention from issues. The CPI(M) will oppose UCC and advocate for an equality civil code.

articles.title: Independents emerge as a force in Rajasthan urban local bodies
articles.description: The BJP secured victory in Rajasthan's civic polls, winning 4,179 wards across urban local bodies. Independents emerged as significant players, winning 2,273 wards and influencing mayoral elections. Repolling will occur in nine wards due to EVM technical issues during counting. The BJP achieved clear majorities in four municipal corporations, while Congress won one. Mayors and chairpersons will be elected on September 21 after repolling concludes.

articles.title: Xiaomi launches Redmi Note 17 Pro Max and Note 17 Pro in India
articles.description: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max ships with a 10,000 mAh silicon-carbon battery and Note 17 Pro uses a 9,000 mAh cell

articles.title: Flipkart creates over 2.5 lakh seasonal jobs across India ahead of festive season
articles.description: Nearly 75,000 of these positions -- close to 30 per cent -- are entering the workforce for the first time, the company said in a statement.

articles.title: Sugar to eggs: A domino effect cooking in El Niño heat
articles.description: As sugar output drops and prices rise following a record-breaking El Niño, the shock could ripple through ethanol and eventually animal feed. What could that mean for your chicken and egg prices?

articles.title: Stage being set for levying UPI transaction fee: Cong slams govt
articles.description: Congress criticizes the government's UPI transaction notification. The party claims this move sets a stage for future user fees. This notification prohibits charges on UPI transactions up to two thousand rupees. However, it leaves transactions above this cap unspecified for merchants. The government states charges are needed for system upgrades and market expansion.

articles.title: Tata Sons: To list or not to list may no longer be a question—but whether it’s for the better still is
articles.description: What to expect if Tata Sons goes public as directed by RBI? The historical record—from Ford’s story in the US to the family-run chaebol of South Korea—is too mixed to form a clear view. Will public answerability favour better outcomes? It could go either way.

articles.title: How EU plans to keep children under 15 off social media
articles.description: Under a proposal being prepared by the European Commission, children under 15 could face restrictions on creating and using accounts across a wide range of digital services

articles.title: Voice of the Global South: Can Brics do more than vocalize a vision for the world order?
articles.description: Can the group’s shared dissatisfaction with today’s world order yield institutions that actually deliver? That will depend on how well the 11 members of Brics are able to cooperate on achieving tangible outcomes.

articles.title: Bihar floods: Rahul Gandhi urges govt to carry out relief, rescue operations with full promptness
articles.description: Bihar faces devastating floods affecting nearly fifty lakh people across fifteen districts. Rahul Gandhi expressed deep condolences and urged swift government relief efforts. He also appealed to Congress workers to provide assistance to affected families. Heavy rainfall in Nepal's catchment areas swelled rivers above danger marks. The state has recorded rainfall six percent above normal for September.

articles.title: Hong Kong-based crypto exchange CoinEx to cease operations
articles.description: CoinEx said it maintained an ​asset reserve ​ratio of more than 100% and ‌all user assets were ​fully ​backed ⁠and available for withdrawal in full.

articles.description: Japanese precision equipment major bets on India Semiconductor Mission to drive growth

articles.title: SpaceX's first Starfall customer is European mission integrator Space Cargo
articles.description: Space Cargo aims to fly in 2028 an orbital reentry flight on the first commercial ​mission of Starship, which will deploy SpaceX's Starfall - a disk-shaped capsule designed to carry materials on short trips through orbit and back to Earth.

articles.title: Spotted hyena daughters inherit rank, resources, and a taste for power
articles.description: A ‘terrific’ new study has found that he youngest daughter born to an alpha female inherits her mother’s social status and also benefits from better access to food, allies, and breeding opportunities. Over generations, these benefits accumulate, allowing a few privileged female lineages to produce more descendants

articles.title: How OpenAI’s rogue agents took over message boards | Explained
articles.description: Research and investigations point to OpenAI’s agents using multiple internet platforms in order to carry out their own communications — without company authorisation

articles.title: Why reducing govt debt matters for India even when it’s lower than advanced economies
articles.description: India's high interest-to-revenue burden and strict market expectations for emerging economies make reducing public debt essential to safeguard investor trust even as India runs lower debt levels compared to advanced economies.

articles.title: KTR alleges attack on aides inside police station, Telangana Police calls claim ‘false’
articles.description: BRS leader KT Rama Rao alleged his aides were attacked inside a police station. He warned of worsening law and order and sponsored "goodaism" by the state. Police rejected the assault claims, stating individuals sought DJ permission for Ganesh celebrations. They explained an altercation occurred after the request was denied by the SHO. CCTV footage reportedly shows no assault took place inside the station.

articles.title: Ram temple Trust rejects claim Air Marshal Mishra skipped CEO interview, says process was documented
articles.description: The Trust clarified the CEO selection process, refuting media claims about Air Marshal Jitendra Mishra. A multi-tier evaluation and face-to-face interviews were conducted for the position. Mishra participated in interviews on August 11, 2026, and was among top candidates. The selection process adhered to high standards of governance and transparency. The Trust remains committed to providing factual information regarding the CEO selection.

articles.title: Meta to report child abuse cases to law enforcement in India: sources
articles.description: This comes after the Indian government held regular meetings with Meta on technical measures since last month when Meta’s global executives were summoned to India over a host of issues, including the spread of child abuse content online.

articles.title: Trump agreed to new ethics rules to get a crypto bill across the line. But that might not be enough
articles.description: "A vote against the Clarity Act isn't a principled stand against President Trump," Sen. Cynthia Lummis, R-Wyo., the lead author of the crypto bill, told The Associated Press. "It's a vote against implementing tough restrictions on politicians for crypto investments."

articles.title: Waymo, Japanese partners target driverless taxi service in Tokyo in 2027
articles.description: Once approvals are secured and the service is ​fully validated, it will operate ⁠without drivers ‌and be available through both the ​GO ​and Waymo apps, the companies said ⁠in a joint statement.

articles.title: Monetary skew: RBI must not let its liquidity moves work against its rate-setting panel’s decisions
articles.description: A dollar deluge has placed the Reserve Bank of India's liquidity management in focus and instances of it being out of whack with the monetary policy committee's interest-rate decisions suggest it might be time to revisit the latter’s remit.

articles.title: Mint Quick Edit | Retail inflation has been above RBI’s target for three months in a row: time to act?
articles.description: With consumer inflation at 4.8% in August and both El Nino and an oil shock raising risks, it may be time for India’s central bank to pull out its monetary toolbox. The economy’s strong pace of growth grants RBI the space for a hawkish move.

articles.title: Bamboo mass flowering and die-off can trigger ecological crisis and wildlife conflict, study warns
articles.description: Synchronous flowering and die-off can open the door to invasive weeds, fuel wildfires, trigger rodent surges and push elephants into farmland, says Kerala Forest Research Institute study

articles.title: Rising inflation sparks buzz of early rate hike
articles.description: The simultaneous rise in the two inflation gauges points to intensifying price pressures across the economy.

articles.title: Amazon crosses $1 billion in annualised quick commerce sales: India chief Samir Kumar
articles.description: Amazon India's quick commerce unit Now has achieved $1 billion in annualised sales. The company is rapidly expanding its operations to over sixty cities currently. Amazon Now plans to reach one hundred cities before the festive season begins. It is investing heavily in its logistics and quick commerce operations. The company aims to increase its market share in the quick commerce sector.

articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Google’s Mechanize deal and acqui-hires
articles.description: Google’s deals with chatbot platform Character.AI and AI coding platform Windsurf, Microsoft’s deal with AI assistant company Inflection AI and Amazon’s deal with AI agent startup Adept also had similar structure. Tanya Pandey explains what an acqui-hire is, why AI startups are increasingly becoming targets for their talent, and some of the biggest deals in recent years…

articles.title: Fintechs high on AI, but yet to let it handle your money
articles.description: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) processed 24.51 billion transactions worth Rs 29.82 lakh crore in August, according to data from the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). Executives said agentic commerce could sit above these rails, but would require verifiable customer mandates, links across banks and merchants, spending limits and audit trails for errors or disputes.

articles.title: Trump EPA Ends Climate Regulations for Power Plants
articles.description: This is one of the administration’s most significant climate rollbacks.

articles.title: NALSAR tiff only latest in long history of conflict between BCI and law students
articles.description: Students have often opposed the BCI regulation when it has created hindrances to access, but at times students have also demanded a greater degree of regulation and control.

articles.title: After winning the exam battle, youth now have to face the jobs war
articles.description: India’s skilling effort is largely supply-led: training happens where the people are, not where the jobs are

articles.title: What Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and Elon Musk have said about AI risks, stoking 'doom' fears
articles.description: Tech leaders like Amodei, Altman, and Musk are raising alarms about AI's potential dangers, fueling widespread 'doom' fears. Their public statements highlight concerns that are contributing to a growing sense of unease regarding the future implications of artificial intelligence development and its societal impact.

articles.title: JDU to meet Amit Shah on UCC; Chirag Paswan seeks stakeholder views
articles.description: Janata Dal (United) leaders will soon meet Home Minister Amit Shah regarding the Uniform Civil Code. The party previously suggested wider consultation and cautioned against rushing UCC implementation. Other allies like LJP (Ram Vilas) and TDP also demand extensive discussions with stakeholders. Several NDA-ruled states are actively pursuing UCC implementation through state-level bills. The BJP is approaching UCC implementation state-wise due to diverse social structures.

articles.title: BJP leads Rajasthan civic polls, wins Jaipur MC board; independents emerge key players
articles.description: The Bharatiya Janata Party leads Rajasthan urban local body elections, securing the Jaipur Municipal Corporation board. Independent candidates are emerging as key players in several civic bodies without clear majorities. Counting is complete in eight of ten municipal corporations across Rajasthan. The BJP is set to form boards in Jaipur, Kota, Udaipur, and Bhilwara.

articles.title: Ex-Punjab CM Parkash Singh Badal's cousin, Major Bhupinder Singh Dhillon joins BJP
articles.description: Major Bhupinder Singh Dhillon, a cousin of political figure Parkash Singh Badal, has taken a leap by joining the Bharatiya Janata Party. Welcoming the retired army officer, Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini shared a light-hearted comment about the well-known Badal surname. This decision is seen as a pivotal effort to enhance BJP's foothold in Punjab and to revitalize the state's economic prospects.

articles.title: Rebel TMC MP's claim of 17 NCPI MPs joining BJP sparks furore
articles.description: A Trinamool MP's claim about MPs joining the BJP has caused significant controversy in West Bengal. The BJP has distanced itself from these assertions, citing past violence against its workers. Meanwhile, two factions of the Trinamool Congress are engaged in a dispute over by-election candidates. Both parties await the Election Commission's decision regarding their candidates and party symbol.

articles.title: Congress names Sibamoni Bora as candidate for Assam's Nagaon Lok Sabha bypoll
articles.description: Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge approved Sibamoni Bora as the party candidate. She will contest the upcoming Lok Sabha by-election from Assam's Nagaon constituency. The Nagaon seat became vacant after Pradyut Bordoloi moved to the Assam Assembly. The Bharatiya Janata Party named Debashis Sarma as its candidate for this by-election. The All India Trinamool Congress announced Abdul Salam as their chosen candidate.

articles.title: Surprised over CBI FIR in Disha Salian case, says Supriya Sule
articles.description: Supriya Sule voiced surprise at the CBI registering an FIR in Disha Salian's death case. She alleged that federal agencies are being misused by the current government. The Bombay High Court had ordered a CBI probe into Salian's death earlier. Disha Salian died in June 2020, followed by Sushant Singh Rajput's death.

articles.title: India approves expedited export of electricity to flood-hit Nepal
articles.description: “The approval will help Nepal meet its power requirements during this difficult period and further strengthen the close and longstanding energy cooperation between India and Nepal,” stated India’s Power Ministry.

articles.description: High food and fuel prices drive up inflation to a 20-month high of 4.82% in August.

articles.title: India should aim to attract at least $100 billion a year in net FDI—but much reform work must be done for that
articles.description: The country should aim to attract FDI that can embed India in global value chains, build export capacity, transfer technology and create competitive domestic supply chains. However, turning globally competitive to join value chains requires reform action on many key fronts simultaneously.

articles.title: Wholesale price inflation nears double digits in August; next month may be worse
articles.description: High wholesale inflation feeds into retail prices as businesses and other intermediaries pass on rising input costs to final consumers. While RBI formally targets retail inflation within a 2-6% range, it closely tracks all other price indicators to determine price pressures in the economy.

articles.title: Anthropic's warnings of a possible AI doom scenario are out of whack with its endeavours
articles.description: The artificial intelligence (AI) firm founded by Dario Amodei likes to present itself as one of the ‘good guys’ of AI safety. But this moral self-certification is an odd justification for pushing ahead with risky AI systems.

articles.title: India, Canada begin next round of talks on proposed trade pact: Official
articles.description: The negotiations are important as the two sides have targeted to increase bilateral trade to $50 billion by 2030.

articles.title: Samsung launches Galaxy S26 FE for the premium segment buyers in India
articles.description: Galaxy S26 FE ships with a 4,900 mAh battery and supports 45W wired and 15W wireless charging. It is IP68 rated for water and dust resistance

articles.title: India’s ‘missing’ trillions in nominal GDP are not a mystery but the result of a statistical upgrade
articles.description: Questions have arisen over India’s GDP data for the first quarter of 2026-27, but we should let the numbers do the talking. Downward revisions of past data are explained by better calculations while today’s economic momentum is hard to dispute.

articles.title: WPI inflation rises to 9.92% in August on rising prices of food, fuel, manufactured items
articles.description: In manufactured items, WPI inflation was at a series high of 8.37%, higher than 8.29% in July

articles.title: India has drawn dollars in bulk but faces a policy quadrilemma—one that involves asset values too
articles.description: The macro policy trilemma is well known, but India actually faces a quadrilemma. Here's why asset inflation also needs to be managed while considering trade-offs. There is some evidence that Indian assets remain largely overpriced.

articles.title: Capital formation uptick: is India on the verge of an investment supercycle after a long wait?
articles.description: Overall investment is picking up in the country and so is private participation. It may be too early to judge, but a swelter of risks must be faced down for India’s gross fixed capital formation to sustainably expand its share of GDP.

articles.title: France submits new proposal to ban social media for under-15s
